title: Walk-in court hours stay the same
subtitle: Main Courthouse · 6800 Burleson Road, Building 310, Suite 175
alt: Unchanged Austin Municipal Court walk-in mitigation hours: Monday through Thursday from 8:30 to 11 a.m. and 1:30 to 3:30 p.m., plus Thursday from 6 to 8 p.m., at the Main Courthouse, 6800 Burleson Road, Building 310, Suite 175. The attorney appearance and jury trial schedule changes separately, effective October 5.

events.label: Morning: 8:30–11 a.m.
events.note: Discuss cases and options with a judge or prosecutor

events.label: Evening: 6–8 p.m.
events.note: The later Thursday docket remains available
